title: Digital Root
description:
## Task

Add up the digits of a number, then the digits of that sum, and so on, until a single digit is left. Return that digit.

## Input

- `n` — a non-negative integer.

## Output

An integer from 0 to 9.

## Example

```python
digital_root(4729)  # returns 4
digital_root(99)  # returns 9
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ `n` ≤ 10^18
